lines: One dial sets the rates on Maple Street. Drag the dial on the bank door, or tap plus and minus, and watch all four neighbors.
Keisha is buying a car. Tap Sign on her card to lock today's rate, then turn the dial again.
Tap Pin this rate to keep these numbers, then turn the dial and compare.
At this rate the loan costs Priya too much. She says no to the second shop.
Borrowing got cheaper. Priya says yes again.
The dial is about to move. For each neighbor, tap Better, Worse or Same. For Priya, tap Yes or No.
For Priya, multiply the loan by the new rate. If two thousand dollars or more is left, tap Yes.
Now tap Turn the dial.
Read each card's reason, then tap Next round.
Read each card's reason, then tap See your recap.
That's all six rounds. Who on the street hopes rates go up, and who hopes they go down? Tap Back to Street to test it.
